successful_question.question: Which saved hotels in ZIP 16802 have a room from October 10 to October 12, 2026, for under $250 total? Compare the total costs.
successful_question.proposed_sql: SELECT h.hotel_id, h.name, h.address, SUM(n.nightly_rate_cents) AS total_cost_cents FROM saved_hotels h JOIN demo_hotel_nights n ON n.hotel_id=h.hotel_id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM saved_hotel_searches s WHERE s.hotel_id=h.hotel_id AND s.zip_code='16802') AND n.stay_date>='2026-10-10' AND n.stay_date<'2026-10-12' GROUP BY h.hotel_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.stay_date)=2 AND MIN(n.rooms_available)>=1 AND SUM(n.nightly_rate_cents)<25000 ORDER BY total_cost_cents,h.hotel_id LIMIT 50
